# Quantour Clients

> Self-hosted client suite for the Quantour signal platform: dashboard,
> Telegram bot, and local API proxy under one API key. This file indexes the
> documentation for LLM consumption.

Docs: https://github.com/admin-quantourapi/quantourapi-clients/tree/main/docs

## Pages

- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every env var per app, defaults, and when to touch them
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): components, ports, WebSocket protocol versioning, identity model
- [Telegram bot](docs/telegram.md): bot setup, /link key flow, command surface, multi-chat model
- [Operations](docs/operations.md): build-before-start, upgrades, SQLite backups, health checks
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): invalid key, 409 conflicts, silent bot, WS version mismatch

## Install (agent wizard)

For automated installs, follow https://quantourapi.com/QUANTOUR_AGENT.md
instead of these pages — it is the canonical agent-native guide.
